title: Principal Compiler Architect
description:
Posted Monday, September 21, 2026 at 11:00 PM
Software AG helps companies to manage and optimize their operations, infrastructure and technology with products that simplify complexity, increase transparency and prepare organizations for change.


Trusted by the world’s best brands for more than 50 years, Software AG’s AI\-enabled process intelligence, application development, high\-performance database, and strategic portfolio management solutions are used by banks, retailers, manufacturers, governments and more.


Software AG’s Adabas database \& Natural development platform are used by the world’s leading organizations to build and deploy high\-performance, mission\-critical applications for IBM Z®, Linux® and cloud. Governments and businesses (in finance, manufacturing, retail and more) tailor these applications to give their organization a distinct competitive advantage and optimize them to meet the most demanding operational service level agreements. With a pledge to innovate Adabas \& Natural to 2050 and beyond, we ensure our customer’s mission\-critical Adabas \& Natural applications are Future ready. Now.


Be you, join us.


**Location\- India**  

**Principal Compiler Architect**  

**The role**
COBOL applications, backed by the legendary resilience, security, and scalability of IBM Z, are among global enterprises’ most valuable assets. They run mission\-critical operations with business logic that is unique to the respective organization.
We are hiring a **Principal Compiler Architect** to own the technical direction of the compiler part of our JOPAZ product, and to grow into leading the team that builds it.  

**What you'll do**
* Own the compiler end to end


* Guard correctness as the top priority


* Define and defend how COBOL semantics map onto the JVM so that compiled programs are behaviorally equivalent to native execution


* Drive performance on the JVM


* Set the technical roadmap for the optimization strategy, make cross\-cutting design decisions, and keep the codebase coherent as it grows


* Collaborate across the product, including mainframe connectivity layers


* Grow into technical and people leadership

  

**What we're looking for (must\-have)**
* Proven, end\-to\-end compiler construction experience – you have built or substantially contributed to a production compiler; not just used compiler frameworks.


* Multi\-year JVM code expertise


* Correctness and semantics engineering


* Architecture\-level judgment for optimization strategies


* Ability to make and defend cross\-cutting technical decisions in a long\-lived codebase


* Technical leadership instincts (mentoring engineers, communicate designs clearly)

  

**Strong plus\-points (not required)**
* Hands\-on COBOL knowledge, or experience with another legacy/ business language and its habits


* z/OS experience: Java on z/OS, zIIP and specialty\-engine offload, JCL/batch, …


* Verification at scale, differential testing, conformance suites, fuzzing, or formal methods

  

Your Contact


Mubina Bhaisaheb\- Senior Talent Acquisition Manager

  

At Software AG we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect and fairness where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, pregnancy, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
  

We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion is critical to our success as a global company, and we seek to recruit, compensate, develop, promote, and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool.

title: RIS AI&Data Data Modernisation SA - L6
description:
**Who We Are:**  

Accenture's Data \& AI practice empowers global enterprises to modernize data foundations, scale generative and agentic AI, and achieve measurable business reinvention. Its end\-to\-end capabilities span data platform modernization, cloud migration of legacy data estates, development of cutting\-edge AI and Gen AI solutions, and production support of AI \& Data applications.
  
  

**You Are:** \[Data Modernization SA]
  
  

As a Data Modernization Presales Solution Architect, you will lead the end\-to\-end solution blueprint and roadmap, acting as the bridge between client vision and technology execution. You will be instrumental in translating business problems into technology solutions and having stakeholder alignment throughout the deal lifecycle. In this role, you’ll gain experience in designing Data modernization solutions, working across global delivery and sales teams. You will work cross clouds, cross industry cross geography giving depth and breadth of exposure. You’ll also deepen your expertise in in emerging technologies like Databricks, Snowflake —preparing you for the future.
  
  

**The Work:**  

Understand RFP/RFIs and translate the business needs into technical architecture (data engineering, data visualization, AI, Gen AI).
  
  

Define end\-to\-end application architectures diagrams (data ingestion to data consumption to AI/ML).
  
  

Align technology components (e.g. Informatica, Power BI, PySpark, Azure ML, Azure Foundry, GCP BigQuery, AWS Glue, Snowflake, Databricks etc.) with business use cases.
  
  

Prepare detailed ADM effort estimates and get them validated with AI \& Data capability SMEs.
  
  

Design optimal staffing models based on onshore/offshore/nearshore mix and pyramid structure.
  
  

Build solution plan power point decks for use in sales and delivery alignment.
  
  

Engage in solution and delivery reviews with leadership across geographies.
  
  

Act as the strategic link between sales and delivery teams.
  
  

Contribute to client\-facing proposals, SOWs, and contracting documents.
  
  

Present and defend your solution in internal and external forums.
  
  

Seamlessly transition the solution to the delivery team post\-deal closure.
  
  

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 10% to 25% depending on business need and client requirements.
  
  

**Here’s What You Need:**  

**Must Have:** Strong Data engineering, Business intelligence experience in SI/application development projects
  
  

Working knowledge of cloud ecosystems – Azure or AWS, or Google Cloud.
  
  

Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel (Pivot tables, filters, vlookup etc.).
  
  

Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills.
  
  

Experience working in cross\-functional and global environments.
  
  

**Experience:** Minimum 12 years of relevant IT industry experience in AI \& Data delivery or Presales
  
  

**Location:** Any city having Accenture office.
  
  

**Education:** 15 years of full\-time education required.
  
  

**Bonus Points If you have:**  

Good PowerPoint skills for leadership and client storytelling.
  
  

External client\-facing experience
